intro: Every word this module’s exercises use, on one deck of flashcards: 283 cards, 126 of them nouns. The vocabulary of this module is precise, stylistically marked vocabulary: register pairs, legal and philosophical terms, and fixed expressions, from the themes Wirtschaft & Recht, Medien & Journalismus, Stil & Rhetorik, Literatur: Kurzgeschichte. Write the German, choose it from four options, or flip the card and rate yourself. A word you miss comes back later in the same run, and stays in your weak words until you get it right three times in a row.
tips[0].title: Register is part of the meaning
tips[0].text: At this stage two words can mean the same and still not be interchangeable. The note on the back often names the plain or colloquial equivalent; learn which one fits a formal text.
tips[0].check.why: erhalten is the formal word for 'receive'; kriegen means the same but is colloquial, and erhält is the wrong form after haben.
tips[1].title: Fixed noun + verb pairs carry formal German
tips[1].text: eine Entscheidung treffen, Maßnahmen ergreifen, Kritik üben, Zweifel hegen, ein Risiko eingehen: the noun brings the meaning and only one verb fits it.
tips[1].check.why: The fixed pair is ein Risiko eingehen: to take a risk.
tips[2].title: Law words that look alike
tips[2].text: der Einspruch, der Widerspruch and die Berufung are all ways of challenging a decision, at different stages; der Vergleich ends a dispute by agreement.
tips[2].check.why: der Vergleich is a settlement; Berufung and Einspruch keep the dispute going.
remember[0]: Never say a noun without its article, not even in your head.
remember[1]: Miss a word? It comes back in the same run. Three correct answers in a row take it off the weak list.
remember[2]: Verbs and adjectives have no article: type them as they stand, like "rechtskräftig".
hook: Collect the precise vocabulary of business, law, media and literature, and learn which word fits a formal text.
